title: ontolint rule detail, schema_version 1
description: The document `ontolint --explain RULE --format json` writes: one rule of the listing with its suggestion and test requirement. Objects are open (docs/report-compatibility.md).

severity.description: Closed enumeration: a new value is a breaking change (docs/report-compatibility.md).
null for a rule that is only proposed.

backend.description: Open enumeration. An implemented rule names its backend (rdflib, pyshacl, robot-docker, cli); a proposed rule the catalogue's text.

scope.description: Open enumeration; null for a proposed rule.

requires.description: Open enumeration; null for a proposed rule.

status.description: The planning state of the rule in the catalogue: implemented or proposed. Not classified as closed by the policy, so a consumer must tolerate another value.

selectable.description: False for a proposed rule and for the pipeline rules (backend cli), which --select and --ignore reject.

opt_in.description: Present, and true, only for the rules of an opt-in family.

suggestion.description: The fix the rule suggests; null for a proposed rule.

test_requirement.description: What the catalogue requires of the rule's tests; null when the rule has no catalogue row.
